delete.description:
Deletes the account. Bookings still to come are cancelled, courts the player owns are closed,
every session ends and the email can be used to sign up again. Asks for the password.

post.description:
Sends the email with the link that confirms the address again. Asking twice within a minute gives 429.
Already confirmed gives 409.

Changes the password and ends every other session: all refresh tokens stop working. The answer holds a new
pair of tokens, so this device stays signed in. A wrong current password gives 403 INVALID_CREDENTIALS.

post.description:
Records a match. The other team has to confirm the score before it counts; an ADMIN who did not play can
record a match as already confirmed.

patch.description:
Changes a match. The score then needs the other team's confirmation again. A confirmed match can only be
changed by an ADMIN.

delete.description: A confirmed match can only be removed by an ADMIN, and then it no longer counts for the stats.

post.description: The other team agrees with the score; from now on the match counts for the stats.
The other team does not agree with the score. The player who entered it can correct it, which asks again.
The club agrees. The court becomes a club court, managed by the club's admins from then on.
The club says no. The court stays as it was.
The owner takes the request back.

post.description:
Asks a club to take over a public or private court. The court's owner (or an ADMIN) asks, and the club's
admins accept or decline; nothing changes until they accept. One request per court at a time.

Keeps the hours free. If some of them are already booked or blocked the answer is 409 SLOT_TAKEN and
`fields.slots` lists them; cancel those bookings first.

get.description:
One day of the club, hour by hour on every court, with who booked each hour and whether it was paid.
For the club's admins.

parameters.description: The day in the club's time zone, "YYYY-MM-DD".
parameters.name: date

post.description:
The booking belongs to the logged-in user and the price always comes from the court. All the hours are taken or none:
if one is already booked the answer is 409 SLOT_TAKEN and `fields.slots` lists the hours that clash.
`MONTH` makes four weekly bookings and `SEASON` weekly bookings up to the club's season end; they share a `seriesId`
and the first one is returned. Times must be on the hour, in the future, inside the court's opening hours,
and at most 90 days ahead.

get.description:
Players see their own bookings, club admins also see their clubs' bookings, ADMINs see all. Soonest first.
Cancelled bookings are left out unless `status` is CANCELLED.

parameters.description: Only the bookings made together by one weekly repeat.
parameters.name: seriesId

parameters.description: Only bookings that start at or after this time.
parameters.name: from

parameters.description: Only bookings that end at or before this time.
parameters.name: to

parameters.description: Page size, 1 to 100. Default 20.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: The nextCursor of the previous page.
parameters.name: cursor

post.description:
Cancels a booking and frees its hours. A player can cancel their own booking until the club's cut-off
(24 hours before the start unless the club says otherwise); club admins, the owner of a court without a club
and ADMINs can always cancel. Cancelling twice does nothing.

parameters.description: Also cancel every later booking made together with this one.
parameters.name: series

post.description:
Notes that the player paid at the club. This is only a note for the club's books; the app takes no payments.
For the club's admins, the owner of a court without a club and ADMINs. Marking twice does nothing.

delete.description: Takes the paid note off again.

post.description:
Emails a link to choose a new password, which works once for an hour. The answer is always 204, whether or not
the email belongs to a player, so the route cannot be used to find out who has an account. Asking again within
a minute sends nothing new.
Sets the new password with the token from the email. Every session of the player ends; they log in again.
Confirms the email address with the token from the email.
